notes: QUITTING THE APP NOW ACTUALLY ENDS IT. One fix, found by the activity log the last release added. Since that log went in it has recorded every quit, and it showed that QUITTING WITH THE WINDOW OPEN LEFT THE APP RUNNING IN THE BACKGROUND: the window closed, and the process sat there, invisible, for up to a day and a half, until the next quit finally ended it. You would not have seen it — the app looked closed. The log made it plain and it was reproduced on demand: press Cmd+Q with your books open, and the app closed its window but did not go. WHY. On the way out the app closes its ledger first, which is the right thing to do, and to get the chance to it briefly holds the quit and then re-issues it. That re-issued quit was not always being honoured. A quit with nothing left to close always was, which is why the SECOND Cmd+Q worked. WHAT CHANGED. The re-issued quit is now made a moment later, from a clean turn of the event loop, and in every trial that alone was enough. And behind it there is now a backstop: if the app is still running a second and a half later with no window on screen, it records that in the activity log and ends itself. It cannot be left running unseen again, and if the graceful path ever fails the log will say so. WHAT YOU WILL NOTICE. Nothing, except that Cmd+Q now means what it says; your ledger is closed properly on the way out exactly as before. NO DATA CHANGES; this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
